text: Of David. I To you, Lord, I call;my Rock, do not be deaf to me, [AA]Do not be silent toward me,so that I join those who go down to the pit. [AB]
Hear the sound of my pleading when I cry to you for helpwhen I lift up my hands toward your holy place. [1] [AC]
Do not drag me off with the wicked,with those who do wrong, [AD]Who speak peace to their neighborsthough evil is in their hearts. [AE]
Repay them for their deeds,for the evil that they do.For the work of their hands repay them;give them what they deserve. [AF]
Because they do not understand the Lord's works,the work of his hands, [AG]He will tear them down,never to rebuild them.
II [2]Blessed be the Lord,who has heard the sound of my pleading.
The Lord is my strength and my shield,in whom my heart trusts.I am helped, so my heart rejoices;with my song I praise him.
III [3]Lord, you are a strength for your people,the saving refuge of your anointed.
Save your people, bless your inheritance;pasture and carry them forever!
